rules.name: Grace period
rules.description: The whole window from the first failure to the point where the entry is flagged to a Tour Manager.

rules.name: Notification schedule
rules.description: Notices go out at 24 hours, 3 days, 5 days and 7 days after the failure, asking the athlete to update their card. The same schedule drives insurance follow-up and recurring membership payments.

rules.name: Retry attempts
rules.description: How many automatic attempts are made after the first failure. Zero means no automatic retry.

rules.name: 1st retry
rules.description: When the first automatic attempt runs after the failure.

rules.name: 2nd retry
rules.description: The last automatic attempt. After this the entry needs a decision.

rules.name: Stop condition
rules.description: Retries stop the moment the position is no longer available. Nothing is chased inside 10 days of the event: an entry still unpaid by then is flagged to a Tour Manager so an alternate has time to travel.
rules.setting: Retries stop when the place is gone

rules.name: Proceed without payment
rules.description: Proceed without payment. A Tour Manager can clear an athlete to compete without paying, for a stated reason. Once set, the athlete is marked as a manual override and is never charged again for this event.
rules.setting: Proceed without payment · Admin or Tour Manager · reason required · 10 in use this season
